issues.description: The review says the benchmark run had 'no failed calls', but the bench ledgers hold 3 error records: gemma-local ReadTimeout (413 s), mimo-flash RemoteProtocolError and mimo-flash ReadTimeout (258 s). The review explains only MiMo's extra records, as in-flight kills, and leaves out Gemma's 1,151 records for 1,150 verdicts. docs/04 T1 repeats the claim.

Dogfood overhead hours were not logged per session for a second increment, although the SPEC rule (carried from the Increment 0 Next SPEC) requires it. The review restates the item instead of closing it (dogfood.sh report shows 0 hours), and its Increment 2 Next SPEC list leaves the requirement out.
The review says the loop-gate task has 38 test items. split.json gives loop_gate/test = 39, and the per-task agreement denominators in results.json are 390 (39 x 10). docs/04 T1 repeats 38.
'Gemma reports confidence 1.0 on every verdict' is wrong: 1 of 1,150 Gemma verdicts has confidence 0.9, and the sweep's escalation rate of 0.00087 at threshold 0.95 reflects it.
The review says Jev gets its 4 error items wrong 'on nearly every repeat'. loop-0020 is wrong on 5 of 10 repeats; the counts are 10, 10, 9 and 5.
The Outcome gives 'about $0.25-1 per run with a flash-tier generator', but the loop-cost table gives ~$0.5 (GLM throughout) and ~$1 (mixed); no row supports $0.25.
About $0.077 of smoke spend rests only on console output and no repository artifact records it, so the $1.73 total cannot be fully verified.
'About $1.73 of the $20 monthly ceiling' mixes September spend (smoke and debug) with October spend (benchmark). The '~20 runs' of headroom for Increment 2 ignores the $1.61 already spent in October.
The carry-over section neither closes nor restates two Increment 0 Next SPEC items: checking sheets generated from source documents, and spot-check rounds numbered and kept.
The T6 heading still reads 'open, Increment 1' after the increment closed without a decision. The review proposes deciding T6 in Increment 2, but docs/04 was not updated to match.

notes: GAPS: 1) The review and docs/04 say 'no failed calls'; 3 error records in bench_gemma-local.jsonl and bench_mimo-flash.jsonl contradict this, and Gemma's extra ledger record is unexplained. 2) Dogfood overhead hours still not logged per session (SPEC rule; second increment missed); restated only, absent from the Next SPEC list. 3) Loop-gate test items are 39, not 38 (split.json, results.json denominators). 4) Gemma confidence is 0.9 on 1 verdict, not 1.0 on every verdict. 5) Jev loop-0020 is wrong on 5/10 repeats, not 'nearly every repeat'. 6) The Outcome's '$0.25-1 per run' is not supported by the cost table (~$0.5 / ~$1). 7) The ~$0.077 of earlier smoke spend is unverifiable from the repository (disclosed). 8) The monthly spend line mixes September and October; the Increment 2 run headroom ignores October spend to date. 9) Increment 0 Next SPEC items 'checking sheets generated from source documents' and 'spot-check rounds numbered and kept' are not explicitly closed or restated. 10) The docs/04 T6 heading still says Increment 1. 11) JDG-P-01 (>=97%) is set 0.6 pt below the value measured on the same 115-item split, with no confidence intervals (disclosed). VERIFIED: every cell of the per-backend table matches results.json, including 'vs Sonnet' ratios of 3.5%/1.3%/1.5%/1.9%; 6,095 verdicts = 5x1150 + 345 raw lines; bench ledger sum $1.6111 = results.json ledger_total_usd <= $8.00; smoke.jsonl $0.038 (60 records, 6 backends); debug.jsonl $0.0078; Jev->Sonnet replay at 0.7 gives 0.976 at 2.77% with 1.65% escalated, and at 0.95 gives 0.982 at 9.7%; Jev->GLM replay recomputed from raw verdicts gives 0.976 at 1.34% of Sonnet cost, p50 187 ms, p95 ~0.39 s (matches docs/02 JDG-P-02); Jev errors are exactly 4 loop-gate items; GLM tokens 852/128 at $0.132/M and Sonnet 1320/103 at $2.58/M blended; loop-cost arithmetic gives 460k in / 96k out tokens, GLM catalogue $0.117, Sonnet catalogue $1.88, mixed ~$0.42, x2 multipliers, $20/$1 = 20 runs and $20/$5 = 4 runs, so R10's 50% trigger does not fire; split 64 dev / 115 test with test SHA 0ae2c8d6f11a... matching results.json; label_check.csv has 9 items (3 per task), seed 20261002, all correct, committed 2aef75b; gate-state.json contains all 7 gates the review lists, and incr1_scoped, benchmark_labeled and trades_decided_1 were approved by Chris Schmidt; ceiling confirmation recorded in docs/01 (commit 12034a1); docs/02 v0.3 JDG-P-01..03 values match the review; docs/04 T1 and T2 each have Scores, Decision and Reverse if; uv run pytest -q gives 208 passed; ruff clean; gate-traceability.sh OK (7 requirements); gate-benchmark-results.sh OK; all six Increment 0 Open items and both Errata items are restated or closed.
